chosen_line.card: All Streams Flow to the Sea

q1_what_did_you_play: I played All Streams Flow to the Sea, then Itto — Superlative Superstrength, both targeting Sludge Spinner. The attacks deal 13 and 14 damage, killing it, while Itto also grants 6 Block.
q2_other_line_considered: I seriously considered playing both copies of Water's Edge and All Streams Flow to the Sea. That line also kills Sludge Spinner for 25 total damage, but gains no Block.
q3_what_it_gave_up: It gave up playing the second Hydro-applying attack and spent two energy on Itto instead; on the printed board, that sacrificed nothing needed for the kill and gained 6 Block.
q4_different_intent: No. With the available information, this line kills the only enemy and is at least as protective as the other lethal line, so a different telegraphed intent would not change it.
